name: JaiCreator Image Popup Lite
author: jaicreator

sections.description:
Image Popup Lite is a free and user-friendly WordPress plugin designed to grab your visitors’ attention with beautiful image popups. Perfect for promotions, announcements, or special offers.

This is the Lite version with essential features. Upgrade to Pro for custom button text, analytics tracking, and priority support.

Core Features (Lite Version)

  • ✅ Simple On/Off Switch – Enable or disable the popup with a single click.
  • ✅ Easy Image Upload – Uses the native WordPress Media Library for simplicity.
  • ✅ Optimized 16:9 Aspect Ratio – Ensures your image looks professional on all modern screens.
  • ✅ Preset Button Text – Choose from 5 preset button text options (Shop Now, Explore, Visit Now, Learn More, Get Started).
  • ✅ Button Color Picker – Select the perfect color to match your brand’s style.
  • ✅ Customizable Button Link – Direct visitors to any URL you want.
  • ✅ 100% Responsive – Looks perfect on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
  • ✅ Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance to ensure your site stays fast.

Pro Features (Upgrade Required)

  • ⭐ Custom Button Name – Write your own unique call-to-action text.
  • ⭐ Advanced Analytics Tracking – Track popup views, clicks, and conversion rates.
  • ⭐ Priority Support – Get help directly from the developer.
  • ⭐ Regular Updates – Stay up-to-date with the latest features and improvements.

Upgrade to Pro Version →

License & Support Policy

  • License Terms: This plugin is licensed under GPL v2 or later. The PHP code is GPL-licensed as required by WordPress.

  • Support Policy: For bugs or errors, please contact us at jaisungwani531@gmail.com. Support does not include free customization.

  • Pro Version: For advanced features like custom button text and analytics, upgrade to Pro.

Credits

Developed by jaisungwani
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jaicreator-image-popup-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Image Popup menu in your dashboard to open the settings panel.
  4. Upload your 16:9 image, configure button settings, and save.
  5. Visit your website to see the popup in action!
sections.faq:
What is the best image size to use?

For the highest quality, we recommend an image with a 16:9 aspect ratio, such as 1920x1080px or 1280x720px.

Is the popup mobile-friendly?

Yes. The popup is designed to be fully responsive and will automatically adapt to fit any screen size.

Can I use my own custom text for the button?

In the Lite version, you can choose from 5 preset options. For custom button text, please upgrade to the Pro version.

Does this version include analytics?

No, analytics tracking is a Pro feature. Upgrade to Pro to access advanced analytics.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Click the “Upgrade to Pro” button in the plugin settings page, or visit this link to purchase the Pro version.

Will my settings transfer to the Pro version?

Yes, when you upgrade to Pro, your existing settings will be preserved.
